newsitem.title: USA: Verio Inc sells $150 mln in notes and warrants.
newsitem.headline: Verio Inc sells $150 mln in notes and warrants.

text.p: Verio Inc said Wednesday it completed the sale of $150 million of senior unsecured notes maturing in 2004 and warrants for common stock.
The transaction was underwritten by Merrill Lynch & Co and Lazard Freres & Co LLC, and was placed with a number of institutional investors.
Verio, a privately-held company, said it will use the proceeds from the offering to finance its ongoing operations and its continuing investments in Internet provider affiliates.
It said it will use a portion of the proceeds to continue investing in and acquiring Internet providers to establish a presence in every major U.S. market.
Verio is an Internet services provider for small and mid-sized business and institutional customers.
